issue: सीताराम के मध्यवासिनी: who or what she dwells 'in the midst' of is not plain.
our reading: who dwell between Sītā and Rāma
alternatives: who dwells within the name Sītārāma; who dwells in the midst of (the hearts of) Sītā and Rāma

issue: एक सिद्धि कवि हिन्द: the poet's signature. सिद्धि is read as his name (it recurs as सिद्धि कवि in cau12 and cau35), हिन्द as 'of Hind (India)'.
our reading: Siddhi, a poet of Hind, composes this Kālī Chālīsā
alternatives: the poet 'Siddhi Hind' (हिन्द a pen-name); 'a poet of Hind composes it for siddhi (attainment)'

issue: कोटि सिद्धि कवि मातु पुरातनि: with the signature reading of do2, सिद्धि कवि is the poet.
our reading: the ancient Mother of countless siddhis and of the poet Siddhi
alternatives: ancient Mother of countless siddhis and of poets; the poet Siddhi saying 'ancient Mother of countless siddhis'

issue: कलि कल्प बिमोचनि: कल्प is read as the aeon; it may stand for कल्मष (the sins of the Kali age).
our reading: deliverer from the Kali age and the kalpa
alternatives: deliverer from the sins (कल्मष) of the Kali age

issue: स्वछन्द रद मारद धुनि माही: रद (teeth) is clear; मारद is not a known word (the glossary marks it '?'), read from मार (slaying).
our reading: baring your teeth at will, amid the sound of slaughter, you alone roar
alternatives: मारद a slip for मार्दल / मृदंग (drum): amid the sound of drums; रद मारद 'the destroyer of teeth'

issue: जयति भक्ति उर कुमति सुमति हे: read as further names in the vocative (she is devotion in the heart, ill sense and good sense).
our reading: victory to you, the devotion in the heart, ill sense and good sense
alternatives: victory to you who put devotion in the heart and turn ill sense to good sense

issue: जय ब्रह्माण्ड सिद्धि कवि माता: read with the signature (do2).
our reading: Victory to the Mother of the universe and of the poet Siddhi
alternatives: Mother who gives siddhi to the universe and to poets
